C0403.title: Exploiting XSS to Steal Cookies for Admin Session Hijacking
C0403.summary: A security researcher built an XSS attack environment and injected malicious script into a page. When a user visited the page containing the malicious script, the payload was triggered and leaked cookies including PHPSESSID. The researcher then used tools such as Cookie Editor to replace the cookie and access the backend without a username or password, reproducing an attack chain from stored XSS to session hijacking.

references.title: [XSS] Stealing User Cookies via XSS - Tencent Cloud Developer Community
